generationInputs.prompt: A stylized design incorporates botanical elements. A thick, dark green curved line begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, and then curves back down and slightly to the left, resembling the left side of a heart shape or a developing vine. Inside this green line are four individual leaf shapes, each a different color. The top leaf is green and oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Below and slightly to the left of the green leaf is a yellow leaf pointing upwards and slightly to the left. A blue leaf is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left. To the right of the blue leaf is a red leaf, oriented horizontally with its tip pointing towards the right. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the blue leaf and extends downwards, partially obscured by the red leaf. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
